items.claim: Michael Oliveira is going to march down Elliott and give him his fourth finish loss.
items.quote: Oliveira is going to march down Elliott. Oliveira is going to hit Elliott very hard and Oliveira is going to give Elliott his fourth finish loss.

items.claim: Nina Milosevic has good striking with fast, accurate hands and some pop.
items.quote: She's good. She has good striking, fast, accurate hands. She has some pop on those hands as well.

items.claim: Nina Milosevic is a very good grappler and wrestler who is opportunistic with submissions.
items.quote: She's a very good grappler, good wrestler, opportunistic submissions.

items.claim: Hailey Cowan is on a three-fight skid and is 0 and 3 in the UFC.
items.quote: She's on a three-fight skin. She's 0 and 3 in the UFC.

items.claim: Hailey Cowan has four losses in her career, with three by submission and one by knockout.
items.quote: Hailey Cowan four or five losses, four of those come inside the distance. She has three submission losses on her record and one knockout loss

items.claim: Bogdan Grad is a BJJ black belt who throws a lot of volume and mixes in takedowns.
items.quote: With Bogdan Grad, he's going to throw a lot of volume. I think he's much more dangerous wherever the fight goes. He's a BJJ black belt... He's going to be mixing in the takedowns.

items.claim: Tofiq Musayev is 36 years old and has a lot of wear and tear with 30 fights.
items.quote: this guy says he's 36 years old... this guy has 30 fights. A lot of wear and tear. A lot of tread on the tires.

items.claim: Tofiq Musayev's cardio is lacking and his durability is waning.
items.quote: I don't think he has the best cardio. I think his durability is waning a bit.

items.claim: Ludovit Klein has several submission wins on his record historically, including guillotines, an armbar, and rear-naked chokes.
items.quote: he has like eight eight seven or eight submissions. He has like a lot of guillotines. He has like an armbar. A rear naked choke or two.
